location.site: Off Zeb Haynes Road; approximately 292 acres north of W. Maiden Road and west of Zeb Haynes Road

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction: Microsoft's May 2026 official construction update states construction was continuing at the Boyd Farms site, with foundations, underground utilities, slabs, electrical vaults, sewer, stormwater, water, fire protection, telecommunications, and medium-voltage work. Catawba County's 2026-06-23 joint statement confirms the broader Microsoft Catawba County program has sites existing or under construction, but no certificate of occupancy, energized IT load, or service date was located for Boyd Farms.
evidence_grade: A- for construction status and location: Microsoft official construction update plus Catawba County statement and USACE public-notice record corroborate the project. B for capacity: 240 MW is a planning/inference figure from five 48 MW buildings reported against USACE filings by an industry tracker, not a Microsoft-published or utility-confirmed energized capacity.

Treat as planned/filed capacity, not delivered capacity or utility-confirmed service.
